scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 strict CPU warm-session performance lane after SLM-CPU-183
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-184 attempts to consume the SLM-CPU-183 manifest gate using committed evidence only.
Committed evidence is insufficient to capture a full Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 per-role bias-presence manifest.
This slice precisely blocks the no-bias fast-path branch on missing role manifest artifacts.
This slice does not implement, select, or enable a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
This slice does not change runtime behavior or default runtime selection.
This slice does not claim allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior.

evidence_review.finding: The code can emit model-init bias finish events with bias present true or false.
evidence_review.reason: No committed Qwen3/Qwen2.5 artifact in this slice contains a complete role_records array derived from this trace for every attention, feed-forward, and output-head role.

evidence_review.finding: These receipts preserve model/tokenizer/backend/fallback identity and record zero sidecar bias materialization calls in the selected committed runs.
evidence_review.reason: Bias materialization counters are aggregate runtime counters, not per-role/layer positive absence evidence.

evidence_review.finding: Some candidate receipts record non-zero bias_materialization_calls when sidecar/candidate paths materialize bias values.
evidence_review.reason: This reinforces the fail-closed policy: absence of materialization in one strict path cannot prove every dense-linear role is biasless.

evidence_review.finding: Dense-linear weights and optional bias are readable, but output storage is still blocked by owned Candle Tensor semantics.
evidence_review.reason: Readability and bias_accessible metadata do not enumerate every model role or prove bias absence per layer.

manifest_capture_status.reason: No committed evidence artifact provides role_records for every required attention, feed-forward, and output-head role with positive bias_present true/false values and output_head_mode.

missing_fields.why_required: Identifies the exact canonical dense-linear role and layer selected by any future no-bias selector.
Separates attention, feed-forward, and output-head semantics for fail-closed allowlisting.
Ties manifest evidence to the exact GGUF or canonical source tensor.
Proves the role record matches the runtime matrix selected by the dense path.
Keeps the gate scoped to Q8_0 and prevents accidental Q4/Q5 inference.
Positive true/false bias evidence is the gate condition; omitted, null, or unknown fails closed.
Records the exact present bias tensor or null when absence is proven.
Prevents treating a mismatched or unrelated bias tensor as valid role evidence.
Distinguishes model-init trace, tensor manifest, absent-in-GGUF, and present-in-GGUF evidence.
Output-head roles may be dedicated lm_head, tied embeddings, or transposed head paths and cannot share one bias decision.
Lets paired receipts bind behavior proof to a specific manifest artifact.
Keeps the manifest tied to the loader/model-init code that produced it.
